options.label: History of stroke, TIA or thromboembolism
Vascular disease (history of MI, PVD or aortic atherosclerosis)

notes: The Lip-Halperin article seeks to improve stroke risk stratification of the CHADS(2) score by adding more points for age >=75 and Vascular disease.
The article suggests aspirin or no treatment for a score of 0, and oral anticoagulation when the score is 2 or greater.
The adjusted stroke risk figures are found in the AHA/ACC/HRS Guideline listed below.
